title: Global Structure, Non-Invertible PQ Symmetry, and the DFSZ Domain Wall Problem
summary: In recent years it has become increasingly clear that the previously overlooked ``global structure'' of symmetry groups can encode significant theoretical structure and, more importantly, have substantial phenomenological implications. With this in mind we re-examine the DFSZ axion, which suffers from a domain wall problem due to the Standard Model generation structure.
